forum.title: jump to bootloader failed in stm32f765
forum.best_answer_content:
Jumping into , dont work on MCUs with empty flash checks. I dont test 765, but other require before jump erase flash part 0. How you try this ? First step is test with hw way .

![MM1_0-1777618366383.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2117d7e3-4b9b-d501-0dfc-641864f0effb.png "MM1_0-1777618366383.png")

after this work, do jump from app.

scraped_replies.html:
Hi MM,

I have gone through the following link:

https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/empty-check-mechanism-on-stm32/ta-p/49369

This says Empty check mechanism need to be done only for the following series:

F0, C0, G0, L0, L4, U0, WL & WB. 

The series I am using is F7. I think Empty Check Mechanism is not applicable for STM32F765.
scraped_replies.author: sajeevan

scraped_replies.html: Empty check is only in system bootloaders. Your own bootloader is normal application here... RESET jump to it one line of code. Call NVIC Reset or start watchdog = reset.
scraped_replies.author: MM..1

scraped_replies.html: do you mean you want to jump from the application to the bootloader software you are writing? the bootloader here means the software you are writing or the bootloader inside the STM32F765 system memory and flashed in the manufacture?
scraped_replies.author: Shirley.Ye

scraped_replies.html: The OP says: "embedded bootloader". That's system memory.
